## 简体中文

### 修复

- 首次激活 Aero Peek 延迟 300ms，避免指针只是经过窗口预览时发生闪烁。
- 当前悬停会话中 Aero Peek 激活后，在不同窗口预览之间立即切换。

## English

### Fixed

- Delayed the first Aero Peek activation by 300ms to prevent flashes when the pointer only passes over a window preview.
- Switched Aero Peek immediately between window previews after it has activated for the current hover session.
